name: Restart, Recall, Reply
source:
The producer ran away with the team in the middle of a game making competition!

What to do?

Start again, naturally!

This is a text-based chat simulation adventure game. In this game, you will start over and experience the game-making process as a producer. Throughout the story, you will encounter all kinds of challenges and learn about the ups and downs the production team has experienced in the past. Each day of your life will also bring you new surprises or accidents, randomizing the game-making process! 

As a new producer, you'll need to make choices by responding to chats, thus influencing the team and the course of the game's production.

Are you looking forward to this game journey? Follow along with us and Restart, Recall and Reply!

[translated from [url=https://blackpineapple.itch.io/restart-recall-reply]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏制作比赛中，制作人带着团队逃跑了！

该怎么办？

重新开始，自然而然！

这是一款基于文字的聊天模拟冒险游戏。在这款游戏中，你将作为制作人重新开始并体验游戏制作过程。在整个故事中，你会遇到各种各样的挑战，了解制作团队过去经历的风风雨雨。你生活中的每一天也会给你带来新的惊喜或意外，使游戏制作过程随机化！

作为新的制作人，你需要通过回复聊天来做出选择，从而影响团队和游戏的制作过程。

你期待这次的游戏之旅吗？跟随我们一起重启、召回和回复！

[译自[url=https://blackpineapple.itch.io/restart-recall-reply]Itch.io[/url]]
